content.short: Joule Finance is a decentralized lending protocol and liquidity hub built on the Aptos blockchain.
content.description: Joule Finance is a comprehensive money market and liquidity infrastructure layer on Aptos, designed to maximize capital efficiency for users and developers. As a core DeFi primitive, it enables seamless lending and borrowing of digital assets through its innovative 'Liquidity Anchors'—plug-and-play modules that allow other dApps to integrate Joule's liquidity natively. The protocol also features a cross-chain bridge for Liquid Restaking Tokens (LRTs), bringing diverse yield-bearing assets into the Aptos ecosystem while maintaining a secure environment.
content.meta: Joule Finance provides decentralized lending and liquidity infrastructure on Aptos. Discover Joule Finance and other DeFi Dapps on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
